en: [lspeed = 0.05]You and Ada head out to the hottest club in town!
[lspeed = 0.05]They're fun and prettier than in their photos. Not a single lie about them being the life of the party was told.
[lspeed = 0.05]Wooo!
[lspeed = 0.05]I love this song!
[lspeed = 0.05]Let's dance until we drop!
[lspeed = 0.05]You better keep up okay? I want to party all night!
[lspeed = 0.05]The energy they carry is electric.
[lspeed = 0.05]While the sparkle of their dress and the body glitter isn’t the only thing that keeps your eyes on them all night, they certainly do help.
[lspeed = 0.05]They clearly feel the spark since they dance close to you all night.
[lspeed = 0.05]You both dance, you twirl them, their dress catching the light.
[lspeed = 0.05]Two cosmos please!
[lspeed = 0.05]You’ll looove the Cosmos here, they’re so good!
[lspeed = 0.05]She handed you the drink once they arrived, clinking their glass against yours.
[lspeed = 0.05]You pretend to drink as much as they do, watching them down pretty sunset colored drinks all night, waiting patiently until they reach their limit.
[lspeed = 0.05]Once they’re ready to go home, probably a little more drunk than they usually let themselves get, you are quick to offer a ride. They giggle roughly.
[lspeed = 0.05]You are sooo sweet…
[lspeed = 0.05]And you simply reply that you were more than happy to take care of them.
[lspeed = 0.05]They accept and you get them to your car with ease… The ride back is quiet, with Ada falling asleep in your seat.
[lspeed = 0.05]You carry them inside, under the cover of darkness.
[lspeed = 0.05]You were hungry.
[lspeed = 0.05]You pull out soy sauce, vinegar, onion, garlic, ginger, oyster sauce, bay leaves and various seasonings. Everything you needed except the main ingredient…
[lspeed = 0.05]You glance over at the octopus then at the clock. The marinade for this dish took a while so you should do it now.
[lspeed = 0.05]Your knife cuts into flesh with no struggle, thanks to the alcohol.
[lspeed = 0.05]You let the meat sit while you get everything else ready so the flavor really soaks into the flesh. You moved around the kitchen, chopping, washing rice.
[lspeed = 0.05]When it was time, you threw your prepared ingredients into a frying pan, waiting for the aromatics to start filling the kitchen.
[lspeed = 0.05]You add the octopus ink, letting it simmer and blanching the octopus so you could add it once the sauce was reduced Perfect.
[lspeed = 0.05]Poor Ada, bright and soft Ada.
[lspeed = 0.05]The Octopus Aquakin who shone like a bright flame, smothered too soon… But at least you got a delicious dinner out of them, right?
